meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: Claude 會用 Vercel 工具把你的網頁應用部署到線上，也能管理專案、網域和環境變數。它會在分享網址前先確認建置成功、部署狀態為 READY，並驗證網址能正常回應。
howto.when: 當你要求部署、發布或交付網頁應用，或要求管理 Vercel 的專案、網域、環境變數時。

say.text: 把目前專案部署到 Vercel 的生產環境
say.note: 會執行正式部署並回傳網址。

say.text: 列出這個專案的部署紀錄
say.note: 會執行 vercel ls 查看清單。

say.text: 把 example.com 加到這個 Vercel 專案
say.note: 會執行 domains add 新增網域。

howto.what_en: Claude can use the Vercel CLI to deploy web apps to Vercel and manage projects, domains, and environment variables. Before sharing a URL, it verifies the build passes, the deployment is READY, and the live URL responds.
howto.when_en: When asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy the current project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Runs vercel deploy --prod and returns the URL.

say_en.text: List recent deployments for this project.
say_en.note: Runs vercel ls to show the list.

say_en.text: Add example.com to this Vercel project.
say_en.note: Runs domains add to attach the domain.
